data.name: Heinrik
data.gender_notes: Heinrik is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the German elements hein, meaning ‘home’ and ric, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘power’. The name Heinrik was popular among Germanic peoples, particularly during the Middle Ages. The name Heinrik carries the meaning “Ruler of the home” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heinrik usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the home and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the power and protection of a home.
data.etymology: Heinrik belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the home.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heinrik total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Heinrik carries a strong sense of belonging and leadership. Historically, it was common among noble families, reflecting the idea of a powerful ruler who protected and provided for his people. It was also the name of several powerful figures throughout history, including St. Henry II, Holy Roman Emperor, who played a significant role in European history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Heinrik can be seen as a reminder of the concept of God as our ultimate ruler and protector. The name's meaning 'home ruler' implies a divine power that provides and sustains, and the idea of home can be interpreted as the peaceful and comfortable dwelling place that God offers us in His loving care. Thus, the name reflects the spiritual truth that God is our true and compassionate ruler, who provides for us and protects us in all aspects of our lives.
